data.long_meaning: The name Kazaana is derived from the Arabic word 'Kazana' which means 'treasure chest' or 'hidden treasure'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the idea of inner purity and the hidden blessings that may be revealed over time. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in the Islamic faith. The name Kazaana carries the meaning “Pure, Hidden Treasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kazaana usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, hidden treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
